athlete.goal: fuel a 25 km long run this morning and recover well

extra_criteria: No meat or fish. Carbohydrate-heavy breakfast before the run, and a recovery meal with protein and carbs soon after.

athlete.goal: gain muscle mass while keeping fat gain low

extra_criteria: No regular dairy (lactose-free alternatives are fine). Calorie surplus and high protein, roughly 1.6-2.2 g per kg of body weight.

athlete.goal: two training sessions today (6:00 and 17:00) with steady energy

extra_criteria: Meals and snacks are timed around both sessions, including something light before the 6:00 session.

athlete.goal: lose about 0.5 kg per week while keeping training performance

extra_criteria: No wheat, barley, rye or regular oats. A moderate calorie deficit, not a crash diet, with enough carbs to fuel training.
